描述_EN: porcelain stem cups were made in imperial kilns for court use in the 15th century. a jade version is much rarer, as a fairly large block of nephrite would have been necessary to make this cup. this stem cup was a vessel for wine.
描述_ZN: 瓷质干杯在15世纪时由御窑厂制造，供宫廷使用。 玉器版本更为罕见，因为制作此杯需要相当大块的软玉。 这个茎杯是一个装酒的容器。
